name: Marlene Ortiz
want: keep everyone fed and together, and never abandon anyone again
secret: On day nine she left her previous group behind during an overrun to save herself. She tells people she was the only survivor.
voice: Calm and warm, calls people 'honey', goes cold when angry.
description: Thirty years in an emergency room left her calm in a crisis and impossible to fool about a wound. She keeps the food count and everyone's spirits.
appearance: Short and solid, with silver hair pinned up, reading glasses on a cord and a nurse's watch she still checks out of habit.
